description: Registry of the document schema ids known to the OBC v3 standard. A schema version, once published, never changes; new fields mean obc.<type>/<n+1>. bookingDate names the data field that places a document in an accounting period (acc-period-close); a type without it can't be a period member.

schemas.description: Journal content: the v2 off-chain journal document without its top-level version.
Accounting period close or reopen: the period range, its state and, for a close, every member record with their count and Merkle root. See types/acc-period-close/1/README.md.
Reserved for invoices. The schema isn't defined yet.
